title: Luscious Russian Lamb Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew featuring lamb, apricot jam, and a rich wine broth, cooked to perfection in a clay pot. This dish is perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large clay pot, combine the lamb, apricot jam, red wine, beef broth, carrots, potatoes, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Cover the pot with a lid and bring the mixture to a boil on the stovetop.
Once boiling, transfer the pot to the preheated oven and cook for 2.5 hours.
After 2 hours, check the stew for tenderness and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
Store any leftovers in the refrigerator for up to 3 days.
Reheat the stew gently on the stovetop or in the oven before serving.
